digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and repair pause coordination
propositions: Bridge execution must be portable across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments using a single packaged Python entrypoint without breaking legacy reconcile workflows
Destructive-repair schedule safety must be owned by a provider-neutral durable gate lifecycle that reads pause snapshots, sets pauses, and releases via git refs without GitHub CLI dependency
Legacy reconcile callers must retain their published defaults, exit behavior, signatures, and mutation boundaries while new noun-based bridge routes are added
Checked-out workflows invoking rebar reconcile --mode must continue operating with preserved behavior and existing environment variables
All local, CI, and bare bridge execution must route through exactly rebar bridge run in src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py with no repository-local runner script required
Repair-pause ownership implementation in _repair_pause.py must use per-invocation tokens, foreign-pause abort semantics, and operator-only recovery without automatic retry
